prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 warm vintage lifestyle photo of an adult woman, optionally matching an approved adult identity reference, sitting comfortably on a woven sofa in a cozy lived-in room. She has long side-parted hair with a small clip, light natural makeup, soft pink lips, and natural dewy skin. She wears a plain cream oversized vintage T-shirt, light high-waisted denim trousers, and white sneakers. Her legs are folded naturally, one hand rests on the cushion, and she turns over her shoulder toward camera with a soft playful expression. Include white pillows, folded clothes in the foreground, a small lamp, and soft warm clutter without readable labels. Use warm dim indoor glow with an optional compact 35mm flash, Olympus MJU II-inspired grain, warm vintage tones, and no text, logo, or watermark.
